claims.quote: Betta antoni is a mouthbrooding labyrinth fish that appears endemic to the lower Kapuas basin in West Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo.

regions.name: Kapuas
regions.quote: Appears to be endemic to the lower Kapuas river basin in the Indonesian province of West Kalimantan (Kalimantan Barat), Borneo.

regions.name: Borneo

regions.name: Sekayan
regions.quote: Separate populations were collected from the Sekayan and Melawi rivers (both Kapuas tributaries) close to the townships of Sanggau and Nanga Pinoh, respectively.
